transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: AirTrain runs free of charge between terminals, with trains every 5–15 minutes. To the New York subway, LIRR trains and city buses — take AirTrain to Jamaica or Howard Beach station, $8.75 one way, children under 5 free. Pay with a contactless card, a phone with Apple Pay or Google Pay, or an OMNY card. Group fare: first passenger $8.75, each additional one $4.50, up to 5 people.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: Taxi ranks are at all terminals; a dispatcher manages the queue, no booking needed. To Manhattan — a flat $70 plus tolls, tip and surcharges from $2.75 to $8.50 depending on time and destination. Approximate fares: to Flushing $60, Downtown Brooklyn $90, LaGuardia Airport $60, Newark Airport $160. No more than 4 passengers per car (5 in a minivan).

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: The only hotel on airport grounds is the TWA Hotel next to Terminal 5. From Terminal 5 it is reached through the tube walkways of the old TWA Flight Center; from other terminals take AirTrain to Terminal 5 and follow the signs.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free unlimited Wi‑Fi: “_Free JFK WiFi” network. Support round the clock: +1 (800) 880-4117.
